description: Long two-way Hybrid conversation (PROTOCOL.md section 5.7), from the TypeScript reference. Synthetic inputs only; keys come from each account seed. Alice starts a 0x04 handshake to Bob, Bob starts his own to reply, and each side sends 32 0x05 messages under its own handshake. Both the recipient (accept) and the sender (recovery from the note) derive session_key from every handshake, and both read every message. Each case is accepted or rejected; an accepted accept case gives the handshake's session_key.
